title: Compat API: negotiate events content type via Accept
body:
### Feature request description

Compat `GET /events` always answers with `application/json`. Newer Docker clients send an `Accept` header and pick how to read the stream from the response Content-Type, so we should negotiate it: `application/x-ndjson` and `application/json-seq` from API v1.52, and `application/jsonl` from v1.53.

### Suggest potential solution

Read `Accept` in the compat events handler, pick the best supported type for the requested API version, and fall back to `application/json` for older versions and for the libpod endpoint.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

No

### Additional context

Split out of the events Accept items in #30164 (v1.52) and #30165 (v1.53).
